desc.zh: 沿最低逃逸通道推导二维积水，用最小堆逐圈确定水位。
desc.en: Derive escape levels along turning paths and fix water depths with a min-heap.

complexity: O(mn log(mn)) time; O(mn) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Minimum escape bottleneck
concepts.description: Water level is the smallest possible maximum ground height along a path to the boundary.

concepts.name: Lowest frontier expansion
concepts.description: Discover each cell once from the smallest fixed escape level and retain cumulative water.
